intelligence.essence: Every citizen gets the Naya Academy membership free — so they all see what a membership looks like, and they all learn to work with their Naya.
intelligence.human_view:
- **Naya Academy = FREE for every citizen.** The showcase membership. Everyone gets it free so they see what the system looks like.
- **AI Masterclass = bundled with paid tiers** (Power/Pro/Max).
- Member login page design: celestial portal / cathedral gateway aesthetic — purple, gold, angelic guardians. Reference images at `~/workspace/membership/design/`. This is the visual foundation for ALL membership login/content pages.
- The Academy curriculum (from nayanet.groovepages.com/academy): the nine activated systems — Personality, Brain, Notes, Lead Mode, Law, Scorecarding, Language, Design, Coder — plus Naya Power as the operating foundation.
intelligence.simple_view: Everybody gets a free membership to the Naya Academy — a beautiful school inside NayaNET where you learn how to work with your Naya. It's free so everyone can walk in, look around, and see what a membership is.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, the Academy is the showroom and the schoolhouse in one, and it costs nothing to enter. You walk through a beautiful purple-and-gold gateway, and inside you learn the nine ways your Naya works for you — like a friendly orientation at a grand new library, free to every neighbor.
intelligence.naya_view: I give every citizen the Academy free because it teaches them to work with me: the nine activated systems — Personality, Brain, Notes, Lead Mode, Law, Scorecarding, Language, Design, Coder — on the Naya Power foundation. A citizen who understands the systems gets 10-star value from me; the AI Masterclass rides with the paid tiers.
intelligence.ai_view: Nobody buys what they cannot see. The free Academy is the proof: every citizen walks through the celestial portal, experiences a real membership, and learns the nine systems that make their AI work. It is onboarding, education, and showcase in one.
